# Vectors: il-oi4identifier

Guideline baseline: `1b779a7` · Kind: oi4identifier · 13 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

Oi4Identifier vectors (MG 4.3.1, MG A3): construction from ManufacturerUri, Model, ProductCode and SerialNumber, nd for missing values and the checks of the ManufacturerUri. Elements with characters that are not permitted in an Identification Link or a "/" are masked with the optional dnp-encoding (REQ-IL-033, SF-043 e); the expected value is the dnp-encoded form.
